scorecard.rationale: The paper-filtered coffee crossover gives a favorable acute mental-fatigue result after pretest abstinence, with only partial masking. A fortified decaf post-nap comparison supports a similar acute direction. Driving and usual-diet exercise comparisons were inconclusive. Controlled capsule studies report more fatigue after short abrupt restriction and a tiredness benefit after abstention. The 2009 normal-use comparison did not establish the same tiredness response. The 1997 Lane reports and the 2015 intake and intervention records have shared or unresolved lineage. Manualized reduction trials measured total intake or pooled symptoms and did not isolate fatigue. A public account describes delayed fatigue followed by improved restfulness. The weight of evidence leaves minimal easing based on the beverage result, with the size and durability of any effect without withdrawal and in Parkinson disease open.
